notes: Pins from the functional diagram (Figure 1, page 1, top view), which is the only pin map in the datasheet; the SOT23-6L package drawing (page 12) does not print pin numbers, so the numbering follows the diagram and must be confirmed in pass2. Pin 1 and pin 6 are both I/O1, pins 3 and 4 are both I/O2 (paired pins per the diagram), as printed. VBUS typed power_in per the requested convention; the datasheet only calls it the protected line. No abs_max_v or rec_v stated in Table 1 (absolute ratings list only ESD peak pulse voltage VPP = 15 kV IEC contact/air, 25 kV MIL-STD-883G, storage and junction temperatures), so none recorded. Params omitted: vrwm_v is not stated as a rating; the only reverse voltage is VRM = 5.25 V as a leakage-current test condition (IRM, Table 2, page 2), not a stand-off rating, so it was not recorded as vrwm_v. vcl_v_at_ipp omitted: Table 2 gives VCL = 12 V (max) at IPP = 1 A and 17 V (max) at IPP = 5 A, two test points and no single stated Ipp, so the human should choose which to record. ipp_a omitted: Ipp appears only as a test condition, no peak pulse current rating is stated. Other values on page 2 (VF, Ci/o-GND, IRM) are not in the requested param list and were not extracted.
